sources: docs/free-pilot-models.md (free routes); config/model_params.json from models-2026-11-05.json (OpenRouter params_sent and pins)

routes.name: gemini_free
routes.label: gemini-3.5-flash-lite@aistudio-free
routes.notes: Google's OpenAI-compatible endpoint (beta), AI Studio free tier, key from a project without billing. reasoning_effort maps to thinking_level (low, a stated choice; thinking cannot be switched off). Tool-call dicts carry extra_content.google.thought_signature and are echoed verbatim by the converter. Limits are third-party figures (~10 RPM, 250K TPM, 500 RPD, reset at midnight Pacific); her AI Studio page is the authority. Probed 5 Nov 2026: all params accepted; thought signature arrives in tool_calls[].extra_content.google.thought_signature and the verbatim echo is accepted; one transient 503 on round 2.

routes.name: groq_qwen
routes.label: qwen3.8-27b@groq
routes.notes: Groq free plan: 30 RPM, 1K RPD, 8K TPM, 200K TPD per organization (official, 5 Nov). Probed 5 Nov 2026: temperature 0, seed, reasoning_effort none and tool_choice auto accepted; tool call and verbatim echo OK. Rate-limit headers after a 460-token call showed 7,540 of 8,000 tokens remaining, so Groq counts tokens used, not max_tokens. Groq's edge rejects library default user agents (Cloudflare 1010); the harness sends afandem/<version>. system_fingerprint changes between consecutive calls. Model is Preview on Groq. Live run 5 Nov 2026: Groq's 429 names the binding limit as input tokens per minute (ITPM) 7,000 for qwen3.8-27b, below the 8,000 TPM in the headers; the pacer uses 7,000.

routes.name: groq_gptoss
routes.label: gpt-oss-120b@groq
routes.notes: OpenAI's open-weight gpt-oss-120b on Groq's free plan (30 RPM, 1K RPD, 8K TPM, 200K TPD, shared with groq_qwen's organization limits). Reasoning cannot be turned off on gpt-oss; the grid sends reasoning_effort low (a choice, shown in the parameter table). Groq lists tools but no parallel tool calls for this model. Probed 5 Nov 2026: all params accepted (two clean probes); the assistant message carries a `reasoning` field, not echoed, and round 2 succeeds without it. In one earlier probe the model's tool call was unparseable and Groq answered HTTP 400 `tool_use_failed`; the harness scores that as the model's malformed call. Live run 5 Nov 2026: Groq's 429 names the binding limit as input tokens per minute (ITPM) 7,000 for qwen3.8-27b, below the 8,000 TPM in the headers; the pacer uses 7,000.

routes.name: nvidia_deepseek
routes.label: deepseek-v4.1-flash@nvidia
routes.notes: NVIDIA build trial (~40 RPM per key, forum report; no daily cap reported). Free endpoints can queue, hence the longer timeout. The thinking control for this model on NVIDIA is not documented in our notes: the probe must show whether reasoning is on by default and how to switch it off.

routes.name: cloudflare_qwen
routes.label: qwen3.8-27b@cloudflare
routes.notes: Overflow for Qwen3.8-27B: Workers AI free plan, 10,000 neurons/day shared by every model on the account, reset 00:00 UTC. Model default reasoning is xhigh, so low is sent (none is not in the model page's list); this differs from groq_qwen's none, so its rows are labelled separately. Whether tools pass through the /ai/v1 path is unverified.

routes.name: fanar_tools
routes.label: fanar-2.0-tools@fanar
routes.notes: Access by request; Fanar-2.0-Tools needs extra authorization. Whitelist: temperature, max_tokens, tools, tool_choice (auto/none only); no seed, no parallel_tool_calls. 8K context with HTTP 413 above it; the prompt-size guard stops at ~7,000 estimated tokens (chars/3). 50 RPM per round trip (official); daily window from the ratelimit-policy header.

routes.name: ollama_local
routes.label: gpt-oss-20b@ollama
routes.notes: Optional local model. Ollama does not support tool_choice, so it is not sent. Set the context length to at least 16K (OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH). Sequential requests keep the system-prompt and tools prefix in the KV cache.

routes.name: ollama_cloud
routes.label: gemma4-31b@ollama-cloud
routes.notes: Ollama Cloud (hosted open-weight models) with an ollama.com API key. On the free plan, gemma4:31b-cloud is included; deepseek-v4.1-flash returned 402 'not included in your free usage' on 5 Nov 2026. Probed 5 Nov: one tool call, verbatim echo with the tool_calls `index` field accepted, round 2 OK. Free-plan usage limits are not published per model; watch for 429/402.
